profile.headline: Software Developer at University of Pennsylvania
profile.summary: For three years I have work with a team of engineers at National Instruments utilizing the SCRUM agile development process to create the FlexLogger product. I have participated in all aspects of the development and release of the product from planning and implementation to testing and verification. Within the first two years I was promoted from an Entry Level Software Engineer to a Staff Software Engineer. I recently resigned from my position to move closer to friends and family. Currently, I have begun work at SafeAuto as a front end web developer helping support their wide variety of applications. Find out more about me by visiting ericgauzens.com
